# 3d

> Turn a prompt, a photo or a video into a 3D reproduction and ship it as an interactive model on a web page, a Blender asset or render, or a web-ready GLB. Installs as an agent skill.

3d turns a prompt, a photo or a video reference into a 3D reproduction, instead of the usual one-shot result (a default scene, washed-out colour, an oversized GLB, an unchecked "looks good"). It decomposes intent and image/video references into a measured spec (`.3d/reference-spec.json`, schema `refspec.v1`), writes an approved brief, shots and look (`.3d/brief.md`, `.3d/shots.json`, `.3d/look.json`) that pass five sign-off gates (brief, style frames, blockout, lookdev, final), chooses an approach and fallback ladder, builds, then shows versioned previews with a captured PNG for every shot until the user approves. It ships as an interactive three.js/R3F model on a web page (a model visitors spin, zoom or configure; a live hero), a Blender asset or render, or a web-ready GLB; shaders, Spline, splats, AR and scroll-driven 3D are further placements. Example: `/3d rebuild the speaker in this clip in 3D — visitors spin it on our product page` with a reference clip. Eight universal rules govern it, including that the brief's core is binding and a ceiling gap is reported, never faked. The SKILL.md router reads only the references the current lane names. Claude Code is the reference host; it is plain Agent Skills format (agentskills.io), so it installs on Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, opencode, Grok Build, and Hermes too.

Triggers: "recreate this in 3D", "make it look like this", "3D hero", "optimize this GLB", "export from Blender", "black R3F scene". Commands run as `<skill>/scripts/<x>` from the project root. Not for 2D scroll/DOM animation (scroll-animation), image/video generation (generate-image, generate-video) or CAD-to-print (manufacturing-workflow).

## Install

- npm/skills.sh: `npx skills add gabros20/3d-skill`
- Clone + installer (per-host targets: claude | codex | cursor | antigravity | opencode | grok | hermes | agents | all): `git clone https://github.com/gabros20/3d-skill && cd 3d-skill && ./install.sh codex`
- Manual copy: `cp -R skills/3d ~/.claude/skills/3d`

## Tools (`<skill>/scripts/<x>`, run from the project root)

- `capabilities`: read-only preflight; writes `.3d/capabilities.md` with tools, stack, Blender and MCP hints, install proposals. Never installs.
- `ref-extract`: per reference `meta.json`, `frames/`, `contact.jpg`, `palette.json`, `luma.json`; video adds `cuts.json`, `motion.json`. Needs ffmpeg.
- `glb-report`: triangles, draw calls, textures, extensions, size against a budget (hero, world, ar); PASS/WARN/FAIL.
- `fit-camera`: solves camera focal length and pose from at least 6 non-coplanar 2D-3D anchors and emits a `shots.v1` shot.
- `spec-check`: validates `refspec.v1`, `shots.v1`, `look.v1`, `feasibility.v1` and `rounds.v1`; exit 1 names the bad fields.
- `preview`: `serve`, `stop`, `new-version`, `capture` (`--clip`, `--pathtrace`), `diff A B`, `match`, `sweep`, `compare`, `rounds` (stop verdict), `board`, `feedback` (most take `--dir`, default `.3d`); viewer with A/B and reference compare, shot captures, SSIM/PSNR, storyboard contact sheet, notes. A fresh-critic gate judges the evidence before the user sees a version.

## Reference inventory (`skills/3d/references/`, 48 files)

Front door
- `intake-grill.md` — vague request to an approved brief: rounds of at most 6 questions with recommended answers.
- `intake-references.md` — image/video references to a spec: mechanical pass plus nine vision passes.
- `refspec.md` — the `refspec.v1` schema and leaf rule.
- `refspec-mapping.md` — refspec fields to camera, light, tone, materials and post starting values.
- `brief-spec.md` — `.3d/brief.md` and `.3d/shots.json` (`shots.v1`).
- `brief-lexicon.md` — vague terms made checkable.
- `brief-approach.md` — real-time or pre-render, fallback ladder, Pipeline section.

Engine and realism
- `engine-choice.md`, `realism-gap.md`, `realism-toolbox.md`, `realism-gate.md` (feasibility gate, `MAX REACHED` stop report)

Shared
- `shared-preflight.md` — capabilities, defaults, one batched install proposal.
- `shared-debug.md` — symptom to confirming check to one change.
- `shared-performance.md` — canonical budgets by target and frame-loop rules.
- `shared-preview.md` — versions, shot captures, the feedback loop.
- `shared-verification.md` — claim-scoped verdicts and the fresh-critic gate.

three.js, R3F and shaders
- `threejs-renderer.md`, `threejs-r3f-next.md`, `threejs-lookdev.md`, `threejs-loading.md`, `threejs-postfx.md`, `threejs-interaction.md`
- `shader-glsl.md`, `shader-tsl.md`

Scroll-driven 3D (optional placement)
- `scroll-conductor.md`, `scroll-adapters.md`, `scroll-video.md` (pre-rendered scrub video)

Design and assets
- `design-art-direction.md`, `design-lookdev-presets.md`
- `asset-acquire.md`, `asset-pipeline.md`

Blender
- `blender-channels.md`, `blender-scripting.md`, `blender-modeling.md`, `blender-shading.md`, `blender-uv-bake.md`, `blender-texturing.md`, `blender-geometry-nodes.md`, `blender-rigging.md`, `blender-animation.md`, `blender-physics.md`, `blender-lookdev-render.md`, `blender-export.md`, `blender-version-traps.md`

Optional
- `spline.md`, `splats-xr.md`, `cad-print.md`, `SOURCES.md`
